name: openshapeforge
//overrides: Both entries lift a transitive pin inside `next` that carries fixed CVEs.
postcss: next pins 8.4.31 exactly, so it cannot float; 8.5.x is a minor
and @tailwindcss/postcss already requires ^8.5.16, so this de-duplicates
the tree rather than adding to it.
sharp: an optional dependency next uses for image optimisation. Nothing
here imports next/image, so it is unused — the bump is free.
Drop an entry once next ships a release that pins the fixed version.
//devDependencies: Root-level only so `examples/tsconfig.json` can resolve Bun's globals. @types/bun is otherwise hoisted under apps/api, which nothing outside apps/api can resolve from.

scripts.typecheck:compiler: bun run check:ts-nocheck && bun run --cwd packages/compiler typecheck
scripts.//typecheck:examples: The shipped example plugins and connectors, which apps/api and packages/compiler both exclude — plugin runtime code the API imports at boot was untypechecked until this existed. tsc comes from apps/api because it is the workspace that depends on it.
scripts.//notices:linux: Regenerates the committed notices on the platform CI checks. The tree has platform-native optional packages, so a macOS run emits darwin variants and fails check:notices. node_modules is cleared inside the container first — installing over a macOS tree yields the UNION of both platforms, not the linux set — and the local install is restored afterwards. See the script header.
scripts.notices:linux: docker run --rm --platform linux/amd64 -v "$PWD":/w -w /w oven/bun:1.3.4 sh -c 'rm -rf node_modules && bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null 2>&1 && bun scripts/gen-third-party-notices.ts' && bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null
scripts.//check:notices:linux: The gate as CI runs it, from any platform. Plain check:notices compares against THIS machine's install, so on a Mac it reports the darwin natives as drift and can never pass — use this before opening a PR. Same container and same node_modules handling as notices:linux.
scripts.check:notices:linux: docker run --rm --platform linux/amd64 -v "$PWD":/w -w /w oven/bun:1.3.4 sh -c 'rm -rf node_modules && bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null 2>&1 && bun scripts/gen-third-party-notices.ts --check' && bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null
